method: apply the eight rectangle-grid orientations to the baseline-subtracted matrices and score whether physical upper/lower separates candidate rows and physical left/right separates candidate columns
conclusion: Transpose best restores relative physical direction in this one manual dataset. It is a display candidate only: do not apply it to the canonical raw storage matrix or production UI until repeated fixed-point tests confirm the transform and the physical dimensions/origin.
privacy_boundary: The transformed heatmap and raw human-contact captures remain ignored under tmp/hardware and are not committed.
